en.t: The capping ceremony was performed by the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 这左大臣的夫人是皇女，所生女儿只有一人，称为葵姬[\[28\]](#part1330.html#m28)。

en.t: This Minister of the Left's wife was an imperial princess, and the only daughter she had borne was called Lady Aoi[\[28\]](#part1330.html#m28).

units.source_text: 皇太子爱慕此葵姬，意欲聘娶，左大臣迁延未许，只因早已有心将此女嫁与源氏公子。

en.t: The Crown Prince admired this Lady Aoi and wished to marry her, but the Minister of the Left delayed and would not consent, because he had long intended to give his daughter in marriage to Prince Genji.
He had already reported this intention to the Emperor.

units.source_text: 皇上想道：“这孩子加冠之后，本来缺少外戚后援人。

en.t: The Emperor thought, "After this boy's capping ceremony, he will by nature have few maternal relatives to support him.

units.source_text: 他既有此心，我就此玉成其事，教她侍寝[\[29\]](#part1330.html#m29)吧。”

en.t: Since he has such a wish, I shall bring the matter to completion and have her attend Genji in his bedchamber[\[29\]](#part1330.html#m29)."

units.source_text: 曾催促左大臣早做准备。

en.t: He had urged the Minister of the Left to make preparations quickly.

units.source_text: 左大臣正好也盼望早成。

en.t: The Minister of the Left, for his part, also hoped the matter would soon be settled.
